initial_plan.answerability: yes: the dataset supports a year-by-year comparison of the cyclist share versus the motorist share within these two recorded fatality categories, but not risk per trip or exposure
initial_plan.metric: annual cyclist deaths as a share of combined motorist and cyclist deaths, with the complementary motorist share
initial_plan.denominator: motorist deaths plus cyclist deaths in the same calendar year
initial_plan.population: police-reported NYC crash rows dated from 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31; fatalities are counted by the motorist and cyclist killed columns

data_check_interpretation: The selected 2013-2025 population contains 2,132,218 crash rows, with 85,546 to 231,564 rows per year. Every year has observed dates from January 1 through December 31, though the file alone cannot verify complete reporting. No selected crash_date values or summed death fields are missing; crash_date is DATE typed, so invalid string encodings are not possible, and no sentinel date is specified. No rows need to be excluded or counted differently; retain all crash rows in the selected years.

final_plan.answerability: yes for comparing the composition of recorded motorist and cyclist deaths by year; the data do not support exposure-adjusted risk or a comparison with pedestrian deaths
final_plan.metric: annual cyclist share and complementary motorist share of combined motorist and cyclist deaths
final_plan.denominator: for each year, summed motorist deaths plus summed cyclist deaths
final_plan.population: all police-reported NYC crash rows with crash_date from 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31, including rows with zero deaths; the denominator includes only fatalities represented by the motorist and cyclist killed columns
final_plan.missing_value_decision: retain all selected rows; the data check found no missing values in either summed death column
final_plan.limitations: The shares describe only the composition among motorist and cyclist deaths, not each group's risk per trip or relative population; pedestrian deaths are excluded from this denominator. The file spans January 1 through December 31 in each year, but that does not prove complete reporting.
